records.predicate: is proposed to be related to
records.quote: Cu2-xSe is an intensely studied, cheap and non-toxic high performance thermoelectric, which exhibits highly peculiar transport properties, especially near the beta-to-alpha phase transition around 400 K, which must be related to the detailed nature of the crystal structure.
records.conditions: Especially near the β-to-α phase transition around 400 K

records.subject: Low-temperature β-Cu2−xSe
records.object: Structure ordered in two dimensions and disordered in the third
records.conditions: Established using 3D-ΔPDF analysis of diffuse single-crystal X-ray scattering; contrary to the three-dimensional periodic structure assumed in prior studies
records.quote: Attempts to solve the crystal structure of the low-temperature phase, beta-Cu2-xSe, have been unsuccessful since 1936.
context_quotes: So far, all studies have assumed that beta-Cu2-xSe has a three-dimensional periodic structure, but here we show that the structure is ordered only in two dimensions while it is disordered in the third dimension.

Using the three-dimensional difference pair distribution function (3D-Delta PDF) analysis method for diffuse single-crystal X-ray scattering, the structure of the ordered layer is solved and it is shown that there are two modes of stacking disorder present which give rise to an average structure with higher symmetry.
modality_evidence: Using the three-dimensional difference pair distribution function (3D-Delta PDF) analysis method for diffuse single-crystal X-ray scattering, the structure of the ordered layer is solved and it is shown that there are two modes of stacking disorder present which give rise to an average structure with higher symmetry.

records.subject: Al or Sb impurity insertion into Mg2Si
records.quote: We theoretically investigate the structural and thermoelectric properties of magnesium silicide (Mg2Si) incorporating Al or Sb atoms as impurities using first-principles calculations.
context_quotes: We optimized the structural properties through variable-cell relaxation using a pseudopotential method based on density functional theory.

context_quotes: We then estimate, on the basis of the optimized structures, the site preferences of the impurity atoms using a formation energy calculation.

The result shows a nontrivial concentration-dependence of the site occupation, such that Al tends to go into the Si, Mg, and interstitial sites with comparable formation energies at low doping levels (< 2 at.%); it can start to substitute for the Mg sites preferentially at higher doping levels (< 4 at.%).
modality_evidence: We theoretically investigate the structural and thermoelectric properties of magnesium silicide (Mg2Si) incorporating Al or Sb atoms as impurities using first-principles calculations.
